standard.summary: 启用后优先读 latent/TE 缓存（*_flux2.npz；命中时该步跳过实时 TE/VAE 编码）。
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

standard_en.summary: Once enabled, the latent/TE cache is read first (*_flux2.npz; on a hit that step skips live TE/VAE encoding).
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

advanced.principle: 启用后优先读 latent/TE 缓存（*_flux2.npz）。需先构建 cache；cached 步跳过 live TE/VAE。

advanced_en.principle: When on, latent/TE caches (*_flux2.npz) are read preferentially. The cache must be built first; cached steps skip live TE/VAE.
